items.difficulty_reason: Let Y be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let f : X -> Y be proper, flat and of finite presentation, and let a be the right adjoint for Rf_* of Lemma labelled lemma-twisted-inverse-image; the lemma asserts (1) that for every closed T in Y, if Q in D_QCoh(Y) is supported on T then a(Q) is supported on f^{-1}(T), and (2) that for every quasi-compact open V in Y and every K in D_QCoh(O_Y) the map (equation-sheafy) is an isomorphism (statement lines 2865-2880). The proof derives both assertions from Lemmas labelled lemma-when-sheafy, lemma-proper-noetherian and lemma-proper-flat, and then removes the technical restriction in part (1) that the complement of T be quasi-compact by writing an arbitrary closed subset as an intersection of such sets (proof lines 2882-2889). Combining the three auxiliary results and passing from closed subsets with quasi-compact complement to arbitrary closed subsets is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
